settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure the game path and memory used at launch.
settings.rootPath.label: Game directory
settings.rootPath.hint: Folder containing game files, libraries and downloaded assets. Press "Browse..." to choose one.
settings.ram.label: Max RAM
settings.ram.hint: Drag the slider to adjust. More RAM helps the game run smoother with heavy shaders/mods, but requires enough memory on your PC.
settings.ram.autoLabel: Automatically recommend RAM based on selected version
settings.java.label: Java
settings.java.hint: Press "Check Java" to see whether the Java installed on your machine is compatible with the selected profile.
settings.network.label: Network & download mirrors
settings.network.mirrorLabel: Automatically fall back to mirrors when Mojang servers are slow/down
settings.network.mirrorHint: Useful when your connection to Mojang is unstable. Used only as a fallback — the launcher still prefers official sources first.
settings.network.proxyHint: Leave empty if you don't use a dedicated proxy/VPN for the launcher.
